record.reason: Primary abstract: Quantizing high-dimensional vectors is fundamental to similarity search, distributed learning, and model compression. Feng, Indyk, Kapralov, Krachun, and Prokhorov established sharp guarantees for an unbiased dithered quantizer based on a randomized Hadamard t Vector quantization for similarity search/distributed learning, not LLM weights/KV.
record.title: Pairwise-Independent Dithering for Single-Stage Hadamard Quantization
